publication_label.title: Publication Label
publication_label.default: Deterministic, machine-verified report; human review pending

position_definition.title: Position Definition
position_definition.default: Mean completed-pass origin and reception locations; not tracking

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Structural sensitivity of a fixed historical passing graph. The selected node and its incident edges are deleted; every other observed edge and isolated player is retained. This does not predict replacement behaviour, goals or what would have happened without the player. Reachability counts ordered pairs connected by a directed path, excluding self-pairs; weak components ignore direction, strong components require paths both ways.

warning.title: Warning
warning.default: Train/tuning predictions are in-sample; calibration data fitted the probability mapping. Only test predictions support held-out evaluation. These are historical shot-occurrence predictions, not causal effects or xG.
